page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps and does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and moderate memory capacity, such as enterprise applications, web serving, and general-purpose database hosting.
